run_completion: run model completion on a DataFrame using vLLM or HuggingFace backend for latent multi-hop reasoning evaluation
run_shortcut_free_evaluation: run shortcut-free evaluation on a DataFrame to assess whether models exploit shortcuts instead of true reasoning
get_df_with_shortcut_free_metrics: get a DataFrame with shortcut-free composability metrics for evaluating latent multi-hop reasoning capability
run_vllm_completion: run prompt completion with vLLM models for a given DataFrame and fact composition type
run_hf_completion: run prompt completion with HuggingFace models for a given DataFrame and fact composition type
